cat > zoom.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# usage: zoom.sh START STEP COLS ROWS OUTFILE  (fine-grained montage)
START=$1; STEP=$2; COLS=$3; ROWS=$4; OUT=$5
python3 - "$START" "$STEP" "$COLS" "$ROWS" "$OUT" <<'PY'
import subprocess,sys
start=float(sys.argv[1]); step=float(sys.argv[2]); cols=int(sys.argv[3]); rows=int(sys.argv[4]); out=sys.argv[5]
n=cols*rows
# use frame-accurate seek per tile via select is heavy; instead use fps sampling
import math
dur=step*n
# label expression: start + n*step  (step may be fractional)
expr=f"{start}+n*{step}"
vf=(f"fps=1/{step},drawtext=text='%{{eif\\:({expr})\\:d}}':x=6:y=6:fontsize=26:fontcolor=yellow:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.7,"
    f"scale=470:264,tile={cols}x{rows}")
cmd=["ffmpeg","-nostdin","-loglevel","error","-ss",str(start),"-i","/workspace/materials/game.mp4","-t",str(dur),
     "-vf",vf,"-frames:v","1","-q:v","3",out]
subprocess.run(cmd,check=True)
print("wrote",out)
PY
EOF
